text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — customer's asking for fully customer-managed networking for private deploys. Key asks: static egress IP preservation across upgrades, BYO BGP sessions, and ability to attach to existing transit. We need to scope this into the roadmap. Thoughts?
Alex Park: Do we have an internal compatibility matrix for this? Static egress implies we can't reassign NAT IPs during upgrades. That impacts installer modes and upgrade choreography. @Jamie Ortiz any runtime constraints?
Jamie Ortiz: Runtime notes: we can support egress stability by using node-level SNAT + preserving assigned EIPs, but node replacement will cause transient failover. Upgrade choreography matters a lot — cordon+drain alone won't guarantee zero-eip-churn under some network topologies.
Tony Ruiz: Customer is pretty strict about zero IP churn. They'll accept short DNS TTL switches but not new egress IPs. We could offer a 'static-egress' opt-in where agents register customer EIPs and do NAT on the agent.
Maria Chen: Proposed acceptance criteria for launch: 1) Customer supplies EIP pool and permits assignment to agents. 2) Upgrade path with <5m of egress interruption in staged upgrade tests. 3) Public docs + rollback playbook. 4) Support for air-gapped/offline installer variants.
Jamie Ortiz: Implementation notes: need CNI hooks for IP reservation, an IPAM mapping persisted across upgrades, and an optional BGP speaker implemented as an agent sidecar (or plumbed to the customer's router). Also need clear firewall/NAT docs.
Alex Park: Prioritization: tie to Tier-2 enterprise upsell deals. Rough estimate: MVP (EIP-preserve) = ~6 dev sprints + 2 QA sprints. BYO-BGP is more invasive — can we de-scope BGP for MVP and ship EIP-preservation first?
Tony Ruiz: Field perspective: customers will ask for BGP quickly, but many only need static egress. Suggest phased approach: MVP = EIP-preserve; Phase 2 = BGP peering; Phase 3 = transit/ASN integration + runbook.
sre-bot: INF ticket created: INF-4123 — "Private deploy: customer-managed EIP preserve MVP" assigned to Jamie Ortiz, due 1766044800.
Maria Chen: :thumbsup: Add rollout criteria: automated smoke tests for egress stability, an upgrade-simulation test suite, and a small field pilot (ACME Corp) before general availability.
Jamie Ortiz: Quick opt-in config sketch:```yaml
network:
  mode: customer-managed
  egress:
    static_eips:
      - 198.51.100.10
      - 198.51.100.11
  bgp:
    enabled: false
```
Alex Park: We also need telemetry: per-tenant egress mapping, Console UI to show assigned EIPs, and alerts for any IP drift. Add these to Console/Observability roadmap.
Tony Ruiz: I'll gather sample customer network diagrams and failure-mode runbook items. Ping me if you want me to include any specific vendor topologies.
Maria Chen: I'll draft a short PRD this week capturing MVP scope and schedule a triage with infra/eng next Wed 9am PT. Anyone object to that cadence?
Jamie Ortiz: SGTM.
Alex Park: :rocket:
